description: This file defines a generic interface 'IAppLogger<T>' which provides logging capabilities abstracted from the ASP.NET Core logging types. It includes methods for logging informational and warning messages.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: A generic interface to standardize logging across the application, avoiding direct dependency on ASP.NET Core logging types.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional arguments.
